_method_version: 2.0.0 replaces a 1.x that had five charts, no scripts, and a headline that was backwards. 1.x reported that the technologies the grid most needs are least likely to survive - batteries 8% against gas 20%. Age-matched, storage is 19.6% and simple-cycle gas 10.0%. The gap was measuring which decade a technology entered the queue: CAISO's gas has a median entry year of 2007 and its storage 2020, and they never overlapped. No 1.x number should be quoted.

sources._missing: No withdrawal date and no study milestones for ANY project. This caps what can be compared: three of the seven charts are CAISO-only by force, not choice.

corpus._key: CAISO queue positions are unique 2,278/2,278; MISO J-numbers unique but for one duplicate. Ids collide across operators, so the key is the pair.
corpus._note: Not committed. Regenerate with harvest.py; both queues update continuously.
corpus._sha_note: First 16 hex of the SHA-256 of the harvested queue.csv on 2026-09-11.

headline._headline: The operator matters more than the technology. Both magnitudes are stated because they differ: pooled across technologies MISO is 1.9x CAISO, per technology holding entry years fixed it is 2.8-3.4x, against a roughly 2x spread between technologies.
headline._miso_rate_by_cohort: The open worry was that MISO's advantage rested on 253 early projects. Its next cohort resolves at 31.9% on 1,187 - the advantage held as the sample grew twentyfold.
headline._caiso_2018_2021: A floor, not a rate. A quarter of that cohort is unresolved and withdrawals resolve years before builds.
headline._two_bottlenecks: Intake is high-volume and fast; the facilities stage is low-volume and slow. Entry deposits address the first and not the second; study capacity the reverse.

not_answerable.is_caiso_unusual_or_miso: Two operators is one comparison. NYISO publishes in the same shape and would settle it.
not_answerable.process_versus_grid: MISO has more transmission headroom and less congestion. The gap is real; attributing it to queue process rather than to the grid itself is not supported by this data.
not_answerable.miso_anything_time_based: MISO dates no withdrawals, so survival curves, death stage and stage lead time cannot be computed for it at all. Included in a cohort survival chart it scored exactly 100%, which is a missing column rendering as a perfect result.
not_answerable.geothermal_precision: 3.2% is the lowest rate here and rests on 31 projects. Do not quote without the n.
